subject: english
title: Unit 1 Grammar 2 App
subtitle: Leo's companion to the Grammar 2 slides: 12 tabs of zero-conditional practice built from the deck — the word games, Dad's weather rules, the six rule games, typed fixes with a live grammar checker, the Sentence Builder Lab, five sorts, SB p. 15 Activity 1, his own rules, the card game, clue rounds, the quiz and a Dribble! soccer-rules round. Dad's view shows Leo's first attempts.

content: Replay each Grammar 2 slide game on his own, with the slides' own sentences first.
Say what he always does when the weather changes, and make sentences that make sense.
Solve problems: a problem → what I do, then what he / she does.
language: Use the zero conditional: If + present, present — and flip it: result + if + condition.
Keep both verbs present, add -s for he / she / it, use one if, and put the comma in when if comes first.
Use academic language: logical, condition, depend. Complete the quiz with at least 80%.
